1.consolidated_definition: Deshonrar un hombre a una mujer. “Y te selen pa que yo no te vaya a comel.” Meléndez Muñoz. También (d)esgraciar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To dishonor a man in front of a woman. "And you're there so I won't go and eat you." Meléndez Muñoz. Also (to) discredit.
